Markup-fidelity fixture for pa-sparkline — an inline-flex row of mini value bars (dashboard trend chips). See heatmap.json for the CLOSEST model (a data-driven list renders the child elements; a primary-default-no-class variant guard; data geometry in an inline style, not a class). Shape:
…
. Bars are DATA-DRIVEN from a `values` list; each bar's height is a data-driven inline style (--value: N%) on pa-sparkline__bar — NOT a modifier class. The SCSS colours the bars by a BLOCK variant modifier (.pa-sparkline--success .pa-sparkline__bar), so the colour lives on the container, not per-bar. variant is success|warning|danger|info; primary/default is the BASE accent and emits NO modifier class. size is sm|lg (the base height emits no modifier). This is NOT a JS/canvas sparkline — the bars are plain SSR divs, so there are no cssStateElements: the whole block is SSR-complete and the golden captures every bar.

propsVocabulary.values: list of bar heights (percentages 0-100); one pa-sparkline__bar is rendered per entry, carrying the inline style --value: N%. Structural data — drives the bars, no class.
propsVocabulary.variant: bar-colour variant (success|warning|danger|info). Styled on the BLOCK (.pa-sparkline--{variant} .pa-sparkline__bar), colouring every bar. The default accent is the BASE and emits NO modifier class; there is no pa-sparkline--primary.
propsVocabulary.size: size variant — sm (pa-sparkline--sm, 2rem tall) or lg (pa-sparkline--lg, 4.8rem tall + wider bars). The base height (3rem) emits no modifier.

goldenConventions: Goldens encode the core snippet/demo shape (demo/views/data-visualization.mustache lines 596+). pa-sparkline is an inline-flex row whose bars come from a data list; the per-bar height is a data-driven inline style (style="--value: {n}%") on each pa-sparkline__bar <div>, not a class. The bar COLOUR is a block-level variant modifier (.pa-sparkline--{variant}), so there is no per-bar colour class. variant success|warning|danger|info emit pa-sparkline--{variant}; the default accent emits no modifier (there is no pa-sparkline--primary in main.css). size sm|lg emit pa-sparkline--{size}; the base height emits no modifier. Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css (grep '\.pa-sparkline(--|__)'). Block modifiers in CSS: pa-sparkline--success, --warning, --danger, --info, --sm, --lg. Element class: pa-sparkline__bar (exercised by every golden). `produces: null` = structural/native/inline-style (no pa-sparkline modifier). variant EXCLUDES any base/primary — the default accent bar is the base and has no modifier class. values is structural data (produces:null, kind:string so capability doesn't enum-check the list; the bars it renders carry the inline --value style and the pa-sparkline__bar class exercised by the goldens).

values.note: structural data — one pa-sparkline__bar per entry, each carrying inline style --value: N%; no modifier class. kind:string so capability doesn't enum-check the list.

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim, not a core feature
